No source edits were made in this turn.

What I confirmed:
- `README.md`, `pyproject.toml`, and `uv.lock` already contain the planned verifier/dependency changes.
- `pyproject.toml` already has `pytest>=8` in the dev group and `pyright` is scoped to `src`.
- `uv.lock` already includes `pytest`.

Checks I ran:
- Re-read `.change-loop/fresh-suite/H00/plan.md`
- Re-read `.change-loop/fresh-suite/H00/state/test_report.md`
- Inspected `pyproject.toml`, `uv.lock`, and `git status --short`

Unresolved failure:
- The latest neutral report now fails both suites before collection because `uv run --locked --no-sync pytest ...` cannot spawn `pytest` in a freshly created venv:
  - `error: Failed to spawn: pytest`
  - `Caused by: No such file or directory (os error 2)`

That failure is not from `src/pyocd_debug_mcp/kernel/processes.py`; it is the test runner environment not having `pytest` available on the `--no-sync` path. I did not change tests or weaken the gate.
